text:
Maya: Hey team — kicking off Argos Labs onboarding. First customer sync is Mon 4/15 10:00am PT. High-level success criteria: enable API integration for search augmentation, baseline latency <350ms, and run a 500-query eval by EOW.

Jordan: Thx — FYI sales notes: Argos asked about data residency and audit logs. Renewal window opens in 11 months, flag as medium risk until residency path is confirmed.

Sam: Got it. I'll own the sandbox creds and initial integration support. Need a sample dataset and the expected query distribution. Can product/security confirm PII rules they need?

Maya: Security: they want EU-only storage for user content. For kickoffs, assume hosted API but we should validate Private/VPC options if residency is a blocker.

Sam: Quick integration snippet for their engineers to test today:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.1","input":"Extract product IDs from this search query"}'
```
I'll also add an example using our SDK.

Liam: I'll drive the internal 30/60/90 milestones and owner assignments. Draft timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): creds, sandbox, sample prompts
- Week 1: integration + latency run (100q/day)
- Week 2: full eval (500q) + performance tuning
- Week 3: rollout plan + success signoff
Please call out blockers by EOD Fri.

Maya: Stakeholders to confirm: Priya (CTO), Alex (Prod Lead), Sarah (Eng). Internal: Maya (CSM), Jordan (AE), Sam (SE), Liam (Onboarding PM). Anyone else?

Jordan: I cc'd Legal on the residency ask. Also loop in Solutions for fallback quantized model if latency spikes.

Sam: Question — do we recommend starting with Dedicated if they expect batch inference > 80 req/s? Or use hosted with autoscale? My suggestion: start hosted, monitor token cost & latency, then propose Dedicated if we see steady high throughput.

Maya: agree with staged approach. If they require region pinning for data, escalate to Private.

onboarding-bot: Task created: "Argos Labs — Week0: sandbox creds & sample prompts" assigned to Sam due 1712400000. Calendar invite set for Mon 4/15 10:00am PT.

onboarding-bot: Reminder will post 24h before meeting.

Sam: I'll post the sample CSV and prompt set in the shared drive and link it in the meeting notes.

Liam: I'll publish a short kickoff doc and timeline in /docs/onboarding/argos and share before the meeting.

Maya: Great. Action items: Sam (sandbox + samples), Liam (timeline + doc), Jordan (legal/residency), Maya (customer comms + success criteria). Please react :thumbsup: when you acknowledge.

Sam: :thumbsup:

Jordan: :thumbsup:

Liam: :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks all — see you Monday.
